how.title: Three steps.
how.sub: Skip the WhatsApp groups and the "I'll call you back tomorrow." Post your task, compare offers, hire the best one.

step1.title: Describe your task
step1.desc: Snap a photo, set your budget, pick a category. Sign in once, then your task is ready for local Fixers.

step2.title: Compare bids
step2.desc: Local Fixers send you their price, ETA, and a short pitch. Read profiles, check ratings, and pick the best fit.

step3.title: Hire & pay when done
step3.desc: Pick your Fixer, get the job done, then pay through Bit or Paybox. Rate your experience to help the next neighbor.

catsSection.title: Whatever you need fixed.
catsSection.copy: Pick a category to see what belongs there, then start the task with the right context already selected.
catsSection.willSelect: We will start your task with {{label}} selected.

ASSEMBLY.desc: Flat-pack furniture, shelving, and home items.
ASSEMBLY.detail: Get help turning boxed furniture and loose parts into something sturdy, level, and ready to use.

MOUNTING.desc: TVs, shelves, mirrors, and wall fixtures.
MOUNTING.detail: Find a fixer who can hang heavy or precise items cleanly, safely, and at the right height.

MOVING.desc: Apartment, office, or single-piece moving help.
MOVING.detail: Book local muscle for small moves, awkward items, and short-distance transport without calling a full moving company.

PAINTING.desc: Room touch-ups, small walls, and paint repairs.
PAINTING.detail: Refresh a room, repair scuffs, or finish small paint jobs with clean edges and less mess.

PLUMBING.desc: Leaks, clogs, faucets, and basic pipe fixes.
PLUMBING.detail: Handle everyday plumbing issues before they become expensive problems, from dripping taps to clogged sinks.

ELECTRICITY.desc: Light fixtures, outlets, and small electrical repairs.
ELECTRICITY.detail: Get small electrical jobs handled by someone comfortable with fixtures, switches, and safe installation basics.

OUTDOORS.desc: Gardens, yards, patios, and exterior fixes.
OUTDOORS.detail: Tidy, repair, or improve outdoor spaces so balconies, yards, and patios are easier to use.

CLEANING.desc: Deep cleans, move-out cleans, and post-renovation cleanup.
CLEANING.detail: Bring in help for serious cleaning jobs that need more than a quick tidy-up.
